messages:
jamie: Quick async check — where are we on pricing/packaging infra deps (metering adapter, billing map, quotas, contracts)? Please reply with: ready | review-needed | blocked(+why) + ETA. Owners: @ankit (metering), @sofia (billing), @chao (quota), @kevin (contracts).

ankit: Metering adapter PR opened, needs a final infra review. PR: #8421. Status: review-needed. ETA: ~24-36h after review. Migration included.

ash: I've asked infra to take a look, pinged infra-owners. Should be able to review in the next business day.

sofia: Billing mapping done for US plans. EU VAT/proration edge case needs product confirmation on rounding direction. Ticket: BILL-4333. Status: blocked (need product decision). ETA: 2-3d after decision.

chao: Quota changes merged into feature branch but e2e failing in staging; rate-limiter rejects requests before quota header is present.
Job: job-4571
Infra ticket: INFRA-2299
Sample error:
```
2026-03-17T09:04:12Z ERROR quota-service req_id=gh12jk status=429 msg="missing quota header before auth"
```
Can the adapter set `x-rw-quota` earlier in the pipeline or should we add a shim?

kevin: Contracts note — some legacy enterprise contracts hard-cap usage. Legal approved an opt-out flag `pricing_legacy_cap`. I'll add an `audit.contract_legacy` field to billing events for reconciliation. Status: ready for SRE gating. Ticket: CON-78.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy for branch pricing/packaging/rollout v2 — 4/4 healthy in staging. deploy-id: dpl-20260317-21

jamie: Action items: @ankit get PR #8421 merged (ash to follow up), @sofia confirm rounding preference in BILL-4333, @chao coordinate with INFRA-2299 and post any config diffs, @kevin open rollout gating with SRE for flag CON-78. If any blocker remains EOD Mon I'll book a 20m sync. Post PR/ticket links here.

ankit: Migration snippet:
```sql
ALTER TABLE metering_events ADD COLUMN plan_id VARCHAR(128);
UPDATE metering_events SET plan_id = plan_ref WHERE plan_ref IS NOT NULL;
```

ash: Reviewed PR comments, left one nits note. Will approve once test coverage for legacy SDKs is added.

sofia: Product confirms: use bankers_rounding for prorations, taxes round-up. Updated BILL-4333.

chao: Noted. INFRA-2299 assigned to infra oncall, they'll try small ordering change to emit `x-rw-quota` before auth. I'll watch job-4571 and report back.

kevin: Opening feature flag rollout ticket now and tagging SRE. I'll attach audit schema change in the ticket.

jamie: Thanks — I'll pull these into the rollout checklist and flag any exec risks if blockers persist by EOD Monday.
